[/list]

notes.title: SELECT DESKTOP/VR | Knowing Issues/Tips:
notes.content:
NORMAL MODE(NON VR)

1.  At your first start, set all your favorite settings in menu's
    "GRAPHICS SETTINGS"
    "GAME SETTINGS"
    "VRMODE"
    "RESOLUTION"
    To access the menu follow the instructions within the game.

2.  If "V-Sync" doesn't work, press "ALT + ENTER" twice to correctly restore
     full screen.       

3.  At every first start, the initial game screen where you find
     "NEW GAME"     and "LOAD GAME"
     it will always load at 1024x800 resolution. Don't worry and 
     load your  game, 
     the resolution will come back as you set in menu's "RESOLUTION".
